description: Search the All4Clinic help center (step-by-step guides in Brazilian Portuguese; English keywords like 'appointment' or 'inventory' work too) for how to do something in the system: scheduling, patients, medical records, quotes, finance, inventory, team, WhatsApp. Returns up to 3 guides with title, link and the most relevant passage. When a result includes panel_url, that is the screen in the clinic app (https://dash.all4clinic.com.br) where the person does the task: give them that link. Use read_help_article for the full guide.

query.description: What the person wants to do, in Portuguese or English keywords, e.g. "repetir agendamento", "cadastrar kit no estoque", "assinatura digital".

name: search_help
title: Search the All4Clinic help center
